title: finding(ci): the merge queue's required-check set is watched by nothing — dropping `Type Check` from it would red no gate and leave no trace
body:
Filed by the `domain:devx` @ objectui PM seat (#5748), session `session_01FhBNJcLRZLe8M87VcUgpKr`, 2026-09-13T18:4xZ. Filed **bare** — ⛔ no `domain:*`, no `priority:*`, no `pm:*`, no assignee. ⛔ This seat does not grade.

## Provenance

Surfaced by the dev working objectui#3535 and ⛔ **correctly not filed there**: that card was fenced to answering whether a type-gate/suppression-window collision can still reach `main`, and this is one level up from its subject. The dev reported it back rather than dropping it, and ⛔ deliberately did not file it themselves. objectui#3535 has since been closed **measured-not-reachable** (closure note `#issuecomment-5655237482`).

## The observation, in the closed card's own words

objectui#3535's sharpest line was:

> 一道**只在有人记得时才生效**的防线不是防线。

It was written about suppression directives. It now applies, unchanged, to the defence that closed it:

> **防线是在的;没有任何东西在看着这道防线。**

## What is actually in place today — measured, not assumed

`GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectui/rules/branches/main` → HTTP 200. Rule types present: `deletion`, `merge_queue`, `non_fast_forward`, `pull_request`, `required_status_checks`. The `merge_queue` rule is PRESENT, source `objectstack-ai/objectui`. Required contexts, **9**, printed in full:

```
Lint
Type Check
Build & E2E
Test (shard 1/4)
Test (shard 2/4)
Test (shard 3/4)
Test (shard 4/4)
Build Docs
Changeset Declaration
```

- `'Type Check' in contexts` → **True**
- nonsense control `'Type Checq' in contexts` → **False** (known direction, hit in the same run)

And `.github/workflows/ci.yml` on `origin/main` subscribes the queue, so the set is not vacuous:

```
:44   merge_group:
:45     types: [checks_requested]
```

⇒ the defence is real and currently load-bearing. ⛔ **This card does not dispute it and asks for no change to it.**

## The gap

That set lives in **ruleset 11776024** — GitHub-side configuration, last updated 2026-08-24. It is mutable, and:

- removing `Type Check` from it reds **no gate**, fires **no alarm**, and leaves **no trace in the repository**;
- it is not reachable from any file a reviewer reads in a diff;
- nothing in `scripts/` or `.github/workflows/` asserts anything about its membership.

⚠️ The historical incident objectui#3535 records (#3489 × #3498 → `main` red on TS2578, hot-fixed by PR #3505) is exactly what that set now prevents. If it silently loses a member, the failure mode returns **in the same shape, with the same silence**, and the card that documented it is closed.

## Candidate shape — ⛔ the implementer measures, does not assume

A pin test asserting that `Type Check` (and, if the implementer judges it right, each of the other 8) is a member of `required_status_checks` at `/repos/objectstack-ai/objectui/rules/branches/main`.

⭐ **The one thing already established, because it is the usual blocker for this shape:** the endpoint is readable with an **ordinary session token** — the HTTP 200 quoted above was taken with one. ⛔ **No admin scope is needed.** That is the fact that makes this cheap rather than impossible.

⚠️ Things the implementer must settle rather than inherit from this card:

1. **Where it runs.** A gate that calls the GitHub API is a different animal from the repo's file-reading gates — offline runs, fork PRs, and rate limits all need an answer. A scheduled workflow may be the right home rather than a PR-time check.
2. **What exactly it pins.** Pinning all 9 contexts by name makes a *legitimate* rename of a job (`Test (shard 1/4)` → anything) red the gate. Pinning only `Type Check` is narrower and matches the incident, but watches less. ⛔ Neither is obviously right.
3. **Whether it belongs to objectui alone.** objectstack has the same queue and the same exposure; ⛔ mirroring is a separate call and ⛔ not part of this card.

## ⛔ What this card explicitly does NOT ask for

- ⛔ **Not** a request to add, remove, rename, or reorder any required context. The set as measured is correct.
- ⛔ **Not** a request to change the ruleset, the merge queue, or `ci.yml`.
- ⛔ **Not** a claim that anything is broken today. Nothing is. This is a **watchdog for a defence that currently works** — the same class as objectui#9145 pinning the letter runs so a closed gap could not reopen.

## The honest limit, carried forward from objectui#3535's dev rather than dissolved

Across all **94** merge-queue rejections on this repo, the failing job is **always a Test shard — not once `Type Check`**. So the queue has never been *observed* rejecting on a type failure specifically. The dev refused to infer from configuration that it would, and this seat agrees with that refusal and ⛔ does not paper over it here. It bears on this card in one direction only: it is a further argument that the `Type Check` leg is **untested in practice**, which is a reason to watch it, not a reason to doubt the reading.

## Dedup

`search_issues` over this repo, four queries, with a hitting control each time (the free-text control `UNGATED_DOCS` → 1 open card, so the zeros below are readings and ⛔ not a false empty from a dead instrument):

| query | open hits |
|:--|--:|
| `required_status_checks` | **0** |
| `"required check"` | **0** |
| `ruleset branch protection` | **0** |
| control `label:domain:devx` | 61 |

Nearest neighbour read in full: **objectui#6596** (*「Machine-enforce human review on governed-surface paths — so the no-bypass rule stops resting on seat discipline alone」*, open, `pm:awaiting-maintainer`). ⭐ Same **family** — a rule that rests on someone remembering — but a ⛔ **different subject and different direction**: #6596 would *add* a new enforcement door for governed paths; this card would *watch an existing one that is already installed*. Its candidate shapes name a required check as a thing to **create**; neither names the membership of the required set as a thing to **assert**. ⛔ Not a duplicate.

## Grading

For triage. ⚠️ Note the shape honestly: it is a watchdog on **mutable off-repo configuration**, a class this repo has little of, so 「is this worth a gate at all」 is a legitimate answer and ⛔ this seat is not pre-empting it.
